data.title: Mears Group Cancels Additional Shares Under Ongoing Buyback Programme
data.description:

Mears Group PLC has continued executing its share buyback programme, repurchasing a total of 149,000 ordinary shares between 7 and 11 September 2026 through Deutsche Bank AG’s London branch. data.title: Mkango issues new shares after warrant exercise as rare earths expansion continues
data.description:
The latest update is out from Mkango Resources ( (TSE:MKA) ).

Mkango Magnetic Materials Ltd. said a warrant holder has exercised 300,000 warrants at seven pence per share, prompting the issue of an equal number of new common shares. The new warrant shares will rank pari passu with existing stock and be admitted to trading on AIM and the TSX-V, taking Mkango’s issued share capital to 389,253,618 shares with none held in treasury.

The modest capital increase underscores ongoing investor engagement as Mkango advances a vertically integrated rare earths strategy spanning recycling plants in the U.K., Germany and the U.S. and development of the Songwe Hill and Pulawy projects. With its assets designated Strategic Projects in the EU and backed by U.S. development funding, the share issuance slightly dilutes existing holders but supports liquidity as the company pursues expansion and a planned NASDAQ listing for its core rare earth operations.

Mkango Magnetic Materials Ltd. is a rare earths-focused company listed on AIM and the TSX-V, aiming to become a market leader in recycled rare earth magnets, alloys and oxides.
